\begin{minipage}{0.95\linewidth}\vspace{4pt}\scriptsize \textit{Notes:} Rows added to panel F. Same-year consumption $\times$ institutions interaction under the null of no effect of consumption on growth: synthetic consumption / GDP anchored on the observed ratio of t $-$ 1, with elasticity to nominal GDP ε\_it = ε\_0 + ε\_1 $\times$ WGI\_i,t$-$1 (gradient: ε\_1 = $-$0.180, from the mechanism panel; no gradient: ε\_1 = 0). ε\_0 = 0.556 is the elasticity at mean institutions in the mechanism regression (with the WGI interaction, 1996--2023); ε\_0 = 0.701 is the elasticity of government consumption to GDP without the interaction (Table A3). Calibrated: drawn residuals multiplied by k = 0.30, the value of a grid from 0.30 to 1.00 whose synthetic ratio has the within-country SD closest to the observed one in each specification. 1,000 replications per design; percentiles of the replication-level share in brackets. Published specification: Mollick and Vianna (2024), Table A12, panel D; approximate replication: Table A12, panel C. Panel E summary: cells of the triple-interaction test (three timings $\times$ FE and System GMM $\times$ all countries and countries in both periods $\times$ two splits of the overlapping years); FE cells use the wild bootstrap p, System GMM cells the Windmeijer-corrected p. The lower rows ICRG/QoG 1996--2020 and ICRG/QoG common sample coincide because every country-period with the ICRG/QoG index also has WGI; they are the same estimate, not a copy error. Exploratory (post-plan, pre-registered in the third plan addendum).\end{minipage}
